text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our summer camp training is beginning, and Matikanefukukitaru is facing it with a grim resolve.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can you think of my current weaknesses in terms of running the Kikuka Sho? Just give me a rough outline.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ouch! But you are right on the money, even if you don't know how to pull a punch.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: No one in my family came out ready to be a stayer from the jump.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So I'm ill-suited for long distances, and on top of that, I don't have a shred of talent! It's the perfect recipe for failure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: However, despite my numerous faults, good fortune has my back! To that end…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm going to scrape together as much good fortune as I possibly can while we're here. I want good fortune spilling out of my ears!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: First, we need to visit a shrine a hundred times for good luck. Let's find one nearby to start building our streak…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, I don't see any around here. What could we do instead…
choice_data_list: How about a hundred shuttle runs on the beach?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, that sounds great! Back at it again with the good ideas, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Repetition is a very important part of entreating the divine. Now, let's hit the beach!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho, spinach leaf-o! Heave-ho, heave-ho, spinach leaf-o!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho, spinach leaf-o! Heave-ho, heave-ho, spinach leaf-o!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sound of her voice comes and goes in waves each time she rapidly zips past me. Her journey to find herself some luck, however, is only beginning…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Clover of the four leaves… Four-leaf clover… There must be a four-leaf clover somewh—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ahaaa! There's one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I found one, Trainer! Well, it's a bush clover, so it's not the real thing. Still, it has four leaves!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Lucky seashell, lucky seashell… Where are you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If I just kick away all this sand that's in the way… Heave-ho, heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa, there's murky water down here. Wait, is this crude oil? Talk about lucky!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, from this day on, the name's Matikane-oil-tycoon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We just need to find one last bit of luck to put an end to our hunt. We've done quite a bit already, but I get the feeling we're still short.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What should I do to end our search on a high note?
choice_data_list: Find the golden scales of a fish.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Golden scales?! That sounds like it'd bring a load of good fortune. I'd like to string them together into a necklace and put it around my neck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Got to find the fish first. Look, some people over there are going trawling!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, can I come with you guys? Caught any golden sparkly fish?! Huh, just some goldfish?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru joins the fishermen on their trawl. She doesn't end up finding a golden fish, but she leaves the experience with a little more upper-body strength.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wishing on a shooting star sounds good! I'm sure there's a lot of stars to be seen around the island south of here. I definitely want to get my wish in!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm, nothing to see yet…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm, nothing tonight either…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: They just won't co—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, there! I just saw one! We did it, Trainer! And all it took was three days of patiently waiting! Yippee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Argh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's so excited, she forgets to make a wish. Still, all that waiting has built her persistence.
